topic: Which secret files the guard refuses to read
detail: SP-042 refuses reads (not only writes) of terms files and of the secret files listed in docs/internals/hooks.md (Self-protection): the files of each space's gh profile and of the default gh profile, orch's Qdrant API key, the netrc file, the AWS CLI's key file and ssh private keys (id_*, not *.pub). Confirm the list or extend it (for example Docker, kubectl, npm or PyPI login files).
